messages:
Anna (People Ops): Heads up — panel for candidate CX-42 scheduled for Thu 3/26 10:00am PT. Need final AV + scribe + debrief owners. Quick cheat-sheet below.

Sam (Engineering): I can cover scribing if needed. Where's the doc?

Anna (People Ops): Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/example-cx42 (please only paste notes under the 'Panel notes' section). Scribes: @Sam confirmed. @Jordan can you own debrief?

Jordan (Interviewer): Happy to own debrief. Quick Q: what's our rubric scale? I've seen 1-5 and A/B/C before.

Maya (People Ops): Use 1-5 (1=insufficient, 5=strong hire). Anchors in doc header. TL;DR: score each competency and add 1-line evidence.

Leo (EngSRE): AV check: we need camera + mic + recording. If on Zoom -> start recording, if on Google Meet -> click 'record' and drop link in doc. If in office room A, AV will auto-record, but check battery on lapel. I'll do an AV test at 9:30 PT.

Rebecca (Hiring Manager): Also remind candidate to agree to recording. Scribe should add 'consent recorded' checkbox in notes.

Jordan (Interviewer): Noted. Any probes we should prioritize? I can focus on system design and testing.

Anna (People Ops): YES — focus areas in doc: system design (30m), debugging (15m), culture fit (15m). Each interviewer picks 1 anchor question. Please keep time.

Sam (Engineering): Quick reminder on timekeeping: set timer at 25/10/5 for each block. Use this snippet in chat: `/timers 25m @Jordan`

deploy-bot: Reminder — recording toggle enabled for 'panel-room-a' at 09:30 PT.

Jordan (Interviewer): One more — rubric examples? can you paste a short sample?

Anna (People Ops): Sure — paste:

```text
Score: 4
Competency: System design
Evidence: Candidate proposed sharding + write-path optimization, sketched tradeoffs, asked about SLOs.
Recommendation: Strong hire (consider pair-programming step)
```

That will be in header as 'example_anchor'.

Maya (People Ops): After panel, debrief cadence: 15 min immediate sync in #hiring-debriefs and finalize scores + notes in doc within 24h.

Rebecca (Hiring Manager): I'll send calendar invite to 10:45-11:00 for wraps. Thanks all.

Sam (Engineering): Got it. Will scribe and add timestamps.

Anna (People Ops): Thanks — @Leo please confirm AV test at 9:30, @Jordan confirm you own debrief, and everyone glance at doc before Thu. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Interviewer): Confirmed. :+1:
